_description: Eos-to-OBS Overlay Bridge configuration example. Copy to config.json and edit.
_obsUrlHint: OBS Browser Source URL: http://127.0.0.1:<websocket.port>/ (do not use file://).

eos._hosts_comment: Console hostnames/IPs to try in order. Default: ["localhost"].
eos._host_comment: Legacy single-host fallback key. Optional. Default: not set.
eos._port_comment: Eos TCP port for OSC + API. Default: 3037.

_cueList_comment: Cue list number to track. Default: 1.

sync._syncInterval_comment: Periodic full sync interval in ms (0 = disabled). Default: 300000. Sync on connect and prefetch of next 2 cues are always enabled.

logging._level_comment: Log level: debug | info | warn | error. Default: info.
logging._logOSC_comment: Log raw OSC messages (very verbose). Default: false.
logging._logState_comment: Log cue state transitions. Default: true.

obsControl._enabled_comment: Enable OBS WebSocket control integration. Default: false.
obsControl._recordStartCueNumbers_comment: Cue numbers that trigger StartRecord. Default: [].
obsControl._recordStopCueNumbers_comment: Cue numbers that trigger StopRecord. Default: [].
obsControl._recordChapterMarkers_comment: Fixed chapter markers fired by cue number. Default: [].
obsControl._useSceneBreakForChapters_comment: Create chapter markers when active cue scene changes. Default: false.
obsControl._UseSceneBreakForChapters_comment: Compatibility alias for older/alternate casing. Default: not set.
obsControl._recordStartDelayMs_comment: Delay before StartRecord after trigger cue fire (ms). Default: 0.
obsControl._recordStopDelayMs_comment: Delay before StopRecord after trigger cue fire (ms). Default: 0.
